messages:
maya: Quick check — NZ-East cutover window is tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC. Wanted to confirm owners for egress/BGP, KMS handoff, and the final smoke test. Who's on point?

sam: I can own egress/BGP. I'll verify peer config and BGP communities tonight. pinging @juan for peering keys. :thumbsup:

juan: Ack. I'll rotate peering keys and post the new PSK in the secure channel after rotation. ETA 22:00 UTC.

lucy: I can take KMS handoff and data residency checklist. Need the list of service accounts that will access the CMK. Can someone paste that here?

maya: Thanks. Service accounts: 
```
redwood-nz-proxy
redwood-nz-ingress
redwood-nz-inference
redwood-nz-logging
```
Also make sure the access policy includes the Dedicated infra role.

dave: Quick heads-up — there's an outstanding PR that changes the proxy egress ACLs: https://github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/412. @sam can you review? We should avoid overlapping changes during the cutover.

sam: On it, reviewing now. If it's green I'll merge before 00:30 UTC and tag with cutover: nz-east. If it needs rollback we'll postpone merge until after the window.

oncall-bot: NOTE: Scheduled maintenance window for nz-east (02:00-04:00 UTC) created by maya. Pager routing will go to eng-oncall during the window.

lucy: For smoke tests I propose: 1) simple generate (latency check), 2) embedding job (throughput), 3) KV cache sanity. I'll post a small test harness link in 30m.

maya: Perfect. Who will run the smoke tests? Can we have one infra + one platform rep to validate?

sam: I'll run infra checks (BGP sessions, egress). @lucy can run the app-level smoke tests.

juan: FYI, peering rotation will cause a 30s transient during BGP flap. Plan for graceful retries.

maya: Noted. Make sure health checks tolerate 60s failures. I've updated the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/nz-east-cutover with the retry guidance.

dave: Also adding a small automation step to unblock if BGP doesn't come up: `kubectl -n infra deploy/restart proxy-egress` — use as last resort.

lucy: Posted smoke harness: https://ci.redwood/internal/jobs/2345 — run `./run-smoke.sh --region nz-east` and share logs.

maya: Thanks all. Final checklist: 
- [sam] merge ACL PR or hold (00:30 UTC)
- [juan] peering key rotation (22:00 UTC)
- [lucy] smoke harness ready + run (02:10 UTC)
- [maya] monitor SLOs and coordinate rollbacks
- [dave] hold restart step if needed
If anything blocks, flag here asap. :eyes:

sam: Noted. I'll update if PR needs changes.

juan: Keys rotated, posted in secure channel.

oncall-bot: REMINDER: 30 minutes until maintenance window for nz-east.
